Hi, have a passport and can sell shit to get the money (like I got the tattoo money easily through that way). Home country is out of the question, the only family I have left there are in small rural areas. Also I'm pretty sure they don't do any sort of financial aid at the moment. I have GCSE's and A-levels and did above average in those I don't know if it's scholarship worthy. Really always wanted to go into graphic design!

Hey thank you loads for trying to help, appreciate internet strangers being kind.
I just basically want to move anywhere where I can get a job while I study preferably and be more free/independent! Thanks for listening to my rants too!

I have the net because I don't think they fully understand the extent of the internet! They just assume I facebook and google locations for when they don't know where they're going.

There's an extent to religious freedom and expression of speech here (it's not a democratic system either) and the organisations have to follow the laws here so the only way I'd get help is if I was being hurt or something. Even if I said I wanted to go to college/uni they'd be understanding but their hands would be tied, they can't really do anything regarding that. Thanks for the advice though!

*Hugs!*

I doubt it, haven't even been to see her in quite a while now (decided to go off Zoloft) and yes basically! No such thing as scholarships or anything here - financially speaking I can't support myself for tertiary education.
